description: Polyphonic ADSR envelope generator from Surge, with a curve switch on each timed stage, tempo-syncable times and a choice of a digital or a modelled analogue envelope.

params.text: Sets the attack time, 0.004 to 32 seconds, or a fraction of a beat when tempo-sync is on.
Sets the decay time, 0.004 to 32 seconds, or a fraction of a beat when tempo-sync is on.
Sets the level the envelope holds while the gate stays high, 0 to 100%.
Sets the release time, 0.004 to 32 seconds, or a fraction of a beat when tempo-sync is on.
Chooses the envelope model: Digi runs the digital envelope, which follows the three curve switches; Anlg runs a modelled analogue envelope, which ignores them.
Picks the attack curve: a square-root curve that climbs fast and then eases, a straight line, or a squared curve that starts slowly and finishes steeply.
Picks the decay curve: a straight line, a squared curve or a cubed curve, each falling away faster at the start than the one before it.
Picks the release curve: a straight line, a squared curve or a cubed curve, each falling away faster at the start than the one before it.
Switches the attack time from seconds to a fraction of a beat at the tempo set by bpm cv.
Switches the decay time from seconds to a fraction of a beat at the tempo set by bpm cv.
Switches the release time from seconds to a fraction of a beat at the tempo set by bpm cv.

inputs.text: A gate above 1V starts the envelope and holds it at the sustain level; letting the gate fall starts the release, and the number of channels here sets the polyphony.
A rising edge restarts the envelope from the level it has reached.
Adds to the A knob, a tenth of its full range per volt.
Adds to the D knob, a tenth of its full range per volt.
Adds to the S knob, a tenth of its full range per volt.
Adds to the R knob, a tenth of its full range per volt.
Sets the tempo that tempo-synced stage times follow, doubling with every volt from 60 BPM at 0V; with nothing patched the tempo is 120 BPM.

outputs.text: The envelope, 0V to 10V, with one channel for each channel of the Gate input.

notes: the output rests at 0V until a gate above 1V arrives at the Gate input; no control on the panel starts the envelope.
the green lamp beside a curve switch is lit while the Mode switch is set to Digi, which is the only setting in which the curve switches do anything.
this module is deprecated and hidden in the module browser; the Surge XT plugin replaces it, and both plugins can be used in one patch.
menu: Skins — a submenu of four colour schemes, listed by file name as Classic.xml, Miami.xml, NewYork.xml and Night.xml; picking one repaints every Surge module in the rack.
